steps: Start with two strokes inside one marquee and a note outside it.
Select all and press Delete. Dismiss the mixed-selection hint.
Marquee both strokes only. Click Zoom in, press Delete and then Undo. Reload.
scenarios.expected: Mixed selection keeps all three objects. The second Delete removes both strokes only. Undo restores their original geometry and order; the note remains.

steps: Select a note and Shift-click a rectangular outline beside it. Group them.
Drag the outline to another position, then undo once.
Ungroup and verify both identifiers and positions.
scenarios.expected: The members share a group and move by the same vector. One undo restores both positions. Ungroup removes both memberships and keeps their positions.

steps: Open four notes in All notes. Select the first through third with Shift.
Press Delete, cancel, then delete the same range and confirm. Undo once.
scenarios.expected: Cancel keeps all four notes and the selection. Confirm removes exactly three. Undo restores the original notes and their directed links.

steps: Click one checkbox in All notes and press Delete; cancel the single-note confirmation and clear the selection.
Primary-click a note row and Shift-click a different row. Open Move to area, type XYZ, move the caret to the start and press Delete, then dismiss the picker.
Click a fourth row to add it to the existing selection and press Delete.
scenarios.expected: The first dialog names the single note. In the area field only X is deleted. The final Delete addresses the four selected notes and keeps every note intact when cancelled.

steps: Pin an unpinned note in a workspace with one other pinned note and a third unpinned note.
In Pinned notes select all visible rows, delete and confirm. Undo and return to Note map.
scenarios.expected: Only the two pinned notes enter the deletion. The third note keeps its content throughout; Undo restores both pins.

steps: Zoom in one step. Focus an expanded parent area with a nested child and note.
Collapse then expand it using arrow keys, descend to the note and press Enter.
Return from the editor.
scenarios.expected: Collapsed branches hide descendants. Keyboard navigation opens the intended note. Returning restores its tree focus and the prior map scale.

steps: Start on the first of 140 alphabetically named notes in the sidebar.
Use End, open the focused item with Enter, and return.
scenarios.expected: The last note can be reached even though it began outside the rendered rows. The editor title and restored tree focus refer to that same last note.

steps: Create an unnamed two-by-two grid. Open its area list and choose Show on map.
Focus its sidebar row and press Delete. Undo and reload.
scenarios.expected: The unnamed grid is usable by its fallback label. Delete removes that grid alone. Its empty 2 × 2 shape and unnamed state survive undo and reload.

steps: In a parent area delete a child area containing a note and another subarea.
Confirm removal, inspect the promoted children, then undo. Collapse and reopen the parent.
scenarios.expected: Both children move to the surviving parent. Undo restores both parent relationships and the link to an outside note.

steps: Start with three pinned notes and free layout. Select the source in Link mode and cancel.
Link the first two notes. Attempt the same link again in reverse.
Switch free layout off and on, then inspect Pinned notes.
scenarios.expected: Cancel makes no link. Exactly one manual link exists between the chosen notes; switching layouts keeps it and all three pins.

steps: Place two notes in adjacent seats of a grid nested in a freeform area.
Drag the first onto the second, then undo. Use Take out of grid on the first and undo again.
scenarios.expected: The two slots swap without replacing either note. Extraction places the note in the parent area. Each undo restores the original seats.

steps: Open grid settings for two notes occupying a two-column, one-row grid. Try shrinking to one seat.
Leave two columns, set horizontal spacing to 120 and vertical to 70, and save. Undo.
scenarios.expected: A one-seat grid cannot accept two notes and the form stays open. The valid pitches save independently. Undo restores the previous grid and both assignments.

steps: Insert a named stage between two existing stages with one note each. Undo.
Right-click the first heading and delete that stage, moving its note to the second stage. Undo.
scenarios.expected: Insertion shifts the second note with its original stage. Destination notes survive stage removal. Each Undo restores the order and exact original slots.

steps: Record a named route through two notes. Move the second stop up and save.
Play it, advance once with the keyboard, then leave with Escape.
scenarios.expected: Playback starts on the second picked note and then shows the first. The original map scale and position return after exiting.

steps: Draw a constrained rectangle. Add a caption with a line break and commit it.
Finish drawing, undo once, then reload.
scenarios.expected: First the map contains one square and the two-line caption. Undo removes only the caption; the square remains after reload.

steps: Delete a note in the first workspace. Switch to another space containing a note with the same ID. Press Undo.
Return to the first workspace and press Undo there.
scenarios.expected: Undo in the other space cannot resurrect or alter the first space’s note. Undo in the original space restores its own title and links.

steps: Pan with the hand tool, switch to Select and zoom in; hide and then reveal the sidebar.
Create a text note via the map shortcut and return. Reset zoom to 100 percent.
scenarios.expected: The note is created at the current camera center. Returning preserves scale and camera center. Resetting scale leaves the note in the workspace.
